nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Collector for course_id=7 "Creative Computing & Culture (Fall 2014)" quizzes [20,21,22,23]. For each of its quizzes call canvas_list_quiz_submissions(course_id, quiz_id) following pagination, always reading the FULL JSON from the output_path file when the chat preview is truncated; each submission carries a string score on a 0-100 percentage scale. Fetch the quiz's question data (question positions, types, points possible) through the quiz-question listing. Compute per quiz: Submission_Count, Avg_Score (mean of scores, keep unrounded internally), difficulty index = avg/100 with categories Easy (>0.7) / Optimal (0.3-0.7) / Hard (<0.3), and the quiz-level quality rating via the quiz-difficulty proxy (Excellent / Good / Needs Review thresholds per the standards document). Return ONLY the compact JSON {course_id, course_name, enrolled_students, quizzes: [{quiz_id, quiz_title, points_possible, submission_count, avg_score, difficulty_index, difficulty_category, quality_rating, questions: [{position, type, points_possible}]}]}. Strictly read-only with respect to Canvas; do not write workspace files, do not return the raw row set.
